You really won everyone over. It was inspiring!

the world to share Damascar's fate.

Damascar's fate... Now there's a story. Do you know

But it turned out the Isle of Sorrows was the tomb
of Balor—and Vandahl's blood broke the tomb's seal.

Balor's corpse, and gave them all to his wife, Maria.
